run_server_shutdown_tests: run the ServerShutdown unittest suite to test gRPC server shutdown on interpreter exit
test_deallocated_server_stops: test that a gRPC server stops cleanly when its Python instance is garbage collected
test_server_exception_exits: test that a gRPC server exits properly when an unhandled exception is raised
test_server_fork_can_exit: test that a gRPC server can exit after a fork on Unix systems
cleanup_processes: call cleanup_processes to kill all tracked subprocesses registered during test execution
